newsitem.title: USA: Data General in pact with Corollary Inc.
newsitem.headline: Data General in pact with Corollary Inc.

text.p: Data General Corp on Monday announced a technology agreement with Corollary Inc which will allow Data General to integrate Corollary's processing technology into its server products.
Financial details of the deal were not disclosed.

Data General said its high-end servers -- high speed computers that hold programs and data shared by all users connected to a local area network -- will be fitted with Corollary's Profusion SMP multiprocessing architecture.
Data General said the agreement is the second established between Data General and Corollary, an Irvine, Calif.,-based developer of multiprocessor technology.
